learning_outcomes.text: Participants understand the thermodynamic and electrochemical principles of fuel cells.
They are familiar with the different types of fuel cells and their applications and know the basic structure of fuel cell systems.
Participants can formulate stationary and dynamic fuel cell process models as a basis for process design.

syllabus_topics: Fuel cell types and their applications
Electrochemical and thermodynamic principles for modeling fuel cells
Stationary and dynamic behavior of fuel cell systems
assessment_rules: The condition for receiving credit points is passing the module exam. The grade's importance for the final grade is weighted by credit points.
bibliography: Larminie, J. and Dicks, A.: Fuel Cell Systems Explained, Wiley, 2003
Pukrushpan, J. et al., Control of Fuel Cell Power Systems, Springer, 2004.
